description: Authored engineering patterns, NOT game-specific evidence

recipes.title: Quête : machine à états
recipes.expected_observable_success: accepted quest flag / observed objective progress
recipes.common_failure_modes: duplicate requests; missing target; reconnect; death
recipes.do_not_assume: Never assume the quest remote name or acceptance result

recipes.title: Quête : preuve de progression
recipes.expected_observable_success: objective count increases after a valid action
recipes.common_failure_modes: quest UI desync; quest cancel; server rollback
recipes.do_not_assume: UI text alone may be stale

recipes.title: Boss : apparition et disparition
recipes.expected_observable_success: boss instance appears with confirmed identity
recipes.common_failure_modes: absent boss; duplicate names; streamed-out NPC
recipes.do_not_assume: Do not assume all NPCs are replicated

recipes.title: Boss : timer de réapparition
recipes.expected_observable_success: observed death and later respawn, measured delay
recipes.common_failure_modes: timer drift; server restart; missing spawn
recipes.do_not_assume: Do not invent exact respawn delay

recipes.title: Boss : attendre le butin
recipes.expected_observable_success: inventory delta / reward UI / stable loot state
recipes.do_not_assume: Do not declare loot picked without observable state

recipes.title: Boss : sélection des cibles
recipes.expected_observable_success: chosen target is alive and eligible
recipes.do_not_assume: Client does not dictate server NPC behavior

recipes.title: Combat : reconnaître un coup
recipes.expected_observable_success: validated health decrease or explicit hit signal
recipes.do_not_assume: Do not infer damage from animation

recipes.title: Combat : respecter les délais
recipes.expected_observable_success: ability available and accepted, bounded call frequency
recipes.do_not_assume: Cannot defeat server-side cooldowns

recipes.title: Projectiles : collisions
recipes.expected_observable_success: projectile ray hit confirmed against valid target
recipes.do_not_assume: Server owns authoritative damage

recipes.title: NPC : navigation
recipes.expected_observable_success: NPC reaches destination under tested obstacles
recipes.common_failure_modes: stuck path; streamed map; unreachable waypoints
recipes.do_not_assume: Requires server-side NPC control

recipes.title: Physique : propriétaire réseau
recipes.expected_observable_success: server/client ownership observed in authorized game
recipes.do_not_assume: Ownership is not equivalent to damage authority

recipes.title: Déplacements : points sûrs
recipes.expected_observable_success: destination reached without collision/unstable reset
recipes.do_not_assume: Only use permitted position changes in target game

recipes.title: NPC : immobilisation réelle
recipes.expected_observable_success: server confirms movement disabled over test interval
recipes.do_not_assume: Client cannot freeze server-owned NPC at will

recipes.title: Personnage : récupération après mort
recipes.expected_observable_success: controller rebinds and resumes after respawn
recipes.do_not_assume: Never reuse destroyed character refs

recipes.title: Loot : collecte confirmée
recipes.expected_observable_success: inventory item count increases / reward event
recipes.common_failure_modes: dropped item not collected; capacity limits
recipes.do_not_assume: Pickup request alone does not prove inventory update

recipes.title: Inventaire : réconciliation
recipes.expected_observable_success: server and client inventories converge
recipes.do_not_assume: Client inventory is not authoritative

recipes.title: Vente : suivi de transaction
recipes.expected_observable_success: currency increase and item decrease verified
recipes.do_not_assume: Internal sell API exists only if the game exposes it

recipes.title: Sauvegarde : profil durable
recipes.expected_observable_success: save/load round-trip passes test
recipes.do_not_assume: DataStore cannot be accessed from arbitrary client

recipes.title: Transactions : anti-doublons
recipes.expected_observable_success: retries preserve exactly-once observable effect
recipes.do_not_assume: Requires server-side idempotency

recipes.title: Pêche : événement de morsure
recipes.expected_observable_success: cast/bite/reel/reward distinct observed states
recipes.common_failure_modes: no bite forever; wrong rod; water movement
recipes.do_not_assume: Do not assume fishing minigame mechanics

recipes.title: Donjon : progression des vagues
recipes.expected_observable_success: wave counter and boss state advance
recipes.do_not_assume: Never fabricate dungeon signals

recipes.title: Donjon : filtres de récompense
recipes.expected_observable_success: selected reward matches declared filter
recipes.do_not_assume: Require observed reward metadata

recipes.title: Réseau : schémas de données
recipes.expected_observable_success: typed payload round-trips and validation passes
recipes.do_not_assume: Do not copy client-supplied authority as trusted

recipes.title: Réseau : tolérance aux pertes
recipes.expected_observable_success: retry limits, ordering and duplicate handling pass
recipes.common_failure_modes: out of order packets; duplicate actions
recipes.do_not_assume: RakNet concepts are not Roblox APIs

recipes.title: Réseau : limite des appels
recipes.expected_observable_success: requests remain bounded with response preserved
recipes.do_not_assume: A client cannot bypass server acceptance

recipes.title: UI : grande liste de résultats
recipes.expected_observable_success: scroll shows all results while responsive
recipes.do_not_assume: Persist full files outside chat transcript

recipes.title: UI : petits écrans
recipes.expected_observable_success: all controls accessible on small viewport
recipes.do_not_assume: Do not assume device resolution

recipes.title: Événements : nettoyage
recipes.expected_observable_success: event listeners disconnected on reload
recipes.do_not_assume: Repeated injection can stack effects

recipes.title: Asynchrone : délais et annulation
recipes.expected_observable_success: operations timeout safely and report status
recipes.common_failure_modes: hung yield; cancelled request still acts
recipes.do_not_assume: Use bounded retries with backoff

recipes.title: Code : historique des versions
recipes.expected_observable_success: diff-based patch can be reversed
recipes.do_not_assume: Never replace stable script without approval

recipes.title: Luau : compilation
recipes.expected_observable_success: luau-compile exits 0 and test bundle passes
recipes.do_not_assume: Compilation is not proof of runtime correctness

recipes.title: Identification : place et univers
recipes.expected_observable_success: public metadata returns correct place/universe IDs
recipes.do_not_assume: A game page does not disclose server-side scripts

recipes.title: Sources : licences et provenance
recipes.expected_observable_success: every code chunk retains source license and commit
recipes.do_not_assume: Public repository does not mean unrestricted reuse

recipes.title: Génération : reprise de tâches
recipes.expected_observable_success: partial artifacts survive client disconnect
recipes.do_not_assume: Persist code files outside assistant message

recipes.title: Retour : apprendre des erreurs
recipes.expected_observable_success: test outcome linked to source version and game version
recipes.common_failure_modes: leaking user code; incorrect success claims
recipes.do_not_assume: Never share private scripts without explicit permission

recipes.title: Vérification : preuves graduées
recipes.expected_observable_success: labels static, mock, observed-in-game correctly
recipes.do_not_assume: Never promise 100% across arbitrary games
